recommendation.reason: Expert-written, reviewed tasks have executable evaluation and reference implementations; the best reported configuration scores 47.7 out of 100.
risks: Performance measurements vary across hosts and repeated runs, requiring a controlled evaluation protocol.
The highest reported score is from a single profiling-augmented run and needs replication.
One nominal anti-pattern category has no instances.

redistribution_questions: Can the derived instances be redistributed under MIT when the upstream projects carry their own licences, e.g. Robot Shop's Apache License Version 2.0?
Do the per-instance LICENSE files (Apache 2.0 in robot-shop) override the repository-level MIT field for those subtrees?
